title: Syncing Directory Groups between Internet & SaaS and Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: The directory groups you configured in Internet & SaaS are automatically available for selection within the Zscaler Client Connector when you configure an App Profile. This allows you to create different profiles for the various directory groups in your organization.

The Zscaler Client Connector groups sync with the Internet & SaaS groups every three hours. In the Zscaler Admin Console, you can check when the next sync will occur. You can also manually sync groups between the portals.

blocks.heading: Checking Next Sync Time and Performing Manual Sync

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > Custom Root Cert.
Under Directory Sync & Custom Root Cert, you can:
View the date and timestamp under Next Directory Group Sync Time.
Manually sync directory groups between the Internet & SaaS and Zscaler Client Connector, by clicking Sync Groups.
